name: portfolio-26
purpose: Design system + look/feel for a personal portfolio site; tokens/components authored here flow into the parent Next app via src/tokens.css.

answers.stack: Next.js 16 · React 19 · Tailwind v4 — the parent app at ../ . Loomling targets it as the publish target and its design system OVERRIDES the app's. No framework is scaffolded inside design/ — it stays a vanilla authoring tool whose approved elements export to the app. See ADR 0027.
answers.deployment: Vercel. design/ is excluded from the deploy via ../.vercelignore.
